page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No margin notes. Signature "U 4" and catchword "re" at the foot.

main_text.p: itaque testantur, nemine redarguente, Ecclesam[?] sui Temporis hanc Doctrinam, & universim approbasse & à majoribus accepisse; hanc item Disciplinam in Politia administranda; hunc ordinem, & hos Ritus in cultu Divino peragendo, & suscepisse pariter, & usurpasse, quis temere rejiciat ipsorum Testimonium? Siquidem in his probitas potius, quam Peritia requiritur. Duum[?] autem esset, valde durum, illos ut malæ fidei Testes ablegare, aut saltem suspectos habere, qui pro Fide Catholica tam strenuè decertarunt, imo & mortem oppetierunt; quæ omne genus falsi tantopere[?] aversatur, ut nec pro salute animarum, pro Deo, ejusque veritate tuenda, mendacium quovis ullatenus permittat. Sed & peritia quoque, non probitate sola, eminuerunt antiquiores ævi Doctores; præsertim in Fidei Dogmatibus, in quibus exquirendis, excolendisque diligentissimam operam navarunt. Itaque, sive fidelitatem in Testando, sive peritiam in Fide, de qua testantur, spectemus, haud facile nos in errorem inducere poterunt; adeoque digni censendi sunt, quorum Testimonium in hoc negotio admittamus.

§. 164. 8. Ut sibi licentiam non assumant, decretoriam sententiam ferendi contra omnes Ecclesias Christi Fidem hodie profitentes, quæ longe lateque per orbem dispersæ sunt. Quod certe fieri non potest, sine summa Temeritate, atque Arrogantia. Siquidem has omnes vel crassæ Ignorantiæ, vel affectati erroris reas peragunt, quod falsa adhuc obstinate tueantur, & sinceram Evangelii veritatem summa perversitate rejiciant, etiam postquam & hanc & ista ipsi (ut arbitrantur) evidentissime demonstraverint. page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "Ecclesam" is printed as "Ecclesam" with the letter i apparently missing; marked [?]. "Duum" is faint and marked [?]. "tantopere" has a stop or blot before "e" and is marked [?]. The printed "tamus." at the end of the first paragraph is the word "admittamus" with its final part on the line. The catchword "re" completes "late-re" on the next page.
